items.title: MCP Protocol
items.body: Native Model Context Protocol. Connect from Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, or any MCP-compatible client.

items.title: REST API
items.body: Standard HTTP POST to /api/call with JSON body. Works from any language, any platform, no SDK required.

items.title: Server-Sent Events
items.body: Stream results for long-running operations. Board renders, map generation, and multi-step game sessions.

items.title: Chess Engine
items.body: Variant analysis, puzzle generation, position evaluation, SVG board rendering, opening books.

items.title: Universal Play
items.body: Start games, make moves, get AI suggestions across chess, draughts, Go, shogi, xiangqi, reversi.

items.title: Hex Maps
items.body: Procedural hex map generation with field-of-view, pathfinding, terrain styles, and SVG export.

items.title: Rules Library
items.body: Full-text search across 46 game rulebooks with 8,400+ indexed entries and variant documentation.

items.title: Asset Gallery
items.body: Browse and search 115 piece sets, 333 board layouts, and hex tile collections with metadata.

items.title: Oracles and RPG
items.body: Oracle tables, scene recipes, character generation, and encounter building for 10 RPG systems.

items.title: Game Sessions
items.body: TI4 drafting, Nukes combat, card deck management, score tracking, and Mod Jam utilities.

items.title: Utilities
items.body: Dice rolling, coin flips, team generation, turn order, timer suggestions.

sections.cta_body: Browse all tools, inspect schemas, fill in parameters, and run live queries against the production server. No authentication required.
